purpose: Teach: マタイ/カンジ/エッセンス/面々/国崎/土屋/大森/樋口

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、教会のマタイ伝の慈善活動を医療チームでご支援します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will support the charity work from the Matthew Gospel at the church.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Measured pace. Even tone — informing, not instructing. Direct eye contact. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、診察記録のカンジ、つまり漢字の正確さを医療チームで保ちます
lines.en: Ren, we'll maintain accuracy in the diagnostic records — the kanji notations — across our medical team.
lines.style: Slight pause before the clarification. Calm, methodical. The tone of someone who values precision. No rush. Quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、診療のエッセンス、つまり本質を医療チームで共有します
lines.en: Ren, we'll share the essence of the diagnostic approach across our medical team.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective. A beat before 'essence' — choosing words carefully. Warm but formal. The voice of someone explaining something important.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療チームの面々で症例検討します
lines.en: Ren, we'll discuss case studies as a full medical team.
lines.style: Straightforward, inclusive. The 'we' lands gently. Professional but collaborative tone. Steady, unhurried.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、国崎半島の僻地医療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will take on the rural healthcare in the Kunisaki Peninsula.
lines.style: Slight weight on 'Kunisaki' — naming the place with respect. Firm but not hard. The tone of someone committing to something real. Clear delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者土屋様のご症状を医療チームで継続観察します
lines.en: Ren, we'll continue to monitor Patient Tsuchiya's condition as a medical team.
lines.style: Clinical but attentive. The patient's name carries care. Steady, reassuring rhythm. The voice of someone who takes responsibility seriously.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、研究者大森博士と医療チームで共同研究します
lines.en: Ren, we'll conduct joint research with Dr. Omori, our research collaborator, and the medical team.
lines.style: Energized slightly — research is purposeful. Clear articulation. Professional but engaged. A thread of possibility running underneath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、言語療法士樋口先生と医療チームで連携します
lines.en: Ren, we'll coordinate with Speech Therapist Higuchi and our medical team.
lines.style: Warm close. Softer attack on the speaker's name. The final word 'team' trails gently — settling into a moment of connection. Intimate without losing professionalism.
